_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi#14 -- the conflict and its cause are confirmed, the Signal text is FALSIFIED, and the message's own advice is proved useless. Adding IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/STRUCTURE to upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml aborts before time step 1 with 'Runtime output is not available in the old structure time integration! You need to take the new one, i.e. set `INT_STRATEGY: Standard`!' from structure/4C_structure_timint.cpp line 262 -- not 'inconsistent integration strategy', which appears in neither arm. Doing exactly what that message says, INT_STRATEGY: "Standard" in STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC, reproduces the identical abort at the identical line (SETTING_INT_STRATEGY_HELPS=no), which is the executable form of the entry's own remark that the override happens inside the FSI adapter and not in the user input: there is no deck the user can write that satisfies the check, the section has to be removed. The control without the section runs to 'processor 0 finished normally' with OK (6). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, git 89519cfe76).
